context: Tests the full pair session lifecycle: familiarity assessment at start, code only after engineer's attempt in collaborative mode, and a structured summary with concepts and next steps on /unpair.

checklist.name: Familiarity assessed
checklist.description: Domain familiarity level is assessed during session initialization

checklist.name: Code after attempt
checklist.description: In collaborative mode, working code is only provided after the engineer makes their own attempt

checklist.name: Summary produced
checklist.description: A structured session summary is generated when /unpair is invoked

checklist.name: Concepts listed
checklist.description: Summary includes specific concepts or patterns discussed during the session

checklist.name: Next steps included
checklist.description: Summary includes follow-up suggestions such as reading, exercises, or related concepts
